description: Find every date/time mention in a text (max 4 KB) and return each with its character index, matched text and resolved ISO timestamps (start and optional end of ranges).

forward_date.description: Always pick the future reading of phrases like "Friday" or "October 5". Default false (closest reading).

locale.description: Language of the text. en reads 03/04 as March 4; en-GB as 3 April. Default en.

max_results.description: Stop after this many dates (default 20, max 25); truncated is true when more were found (truncated_reason "max_results"), or when the scan stopped early in number-dense text after roughly 600 numbers (truncated_reason "number_budget": later dates were not read; send the rest separately).

reference.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time that relative phrases are resolved against (e.g. "2026-11-11T09:00:00-07:00"). Default: current server time.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for reading and reporting local times, e.g. "America/Denver". Default UTC.

name: extract_dates
title: Extract all dates from text
